documentation: src/kernel_loader.cpp (NmathBundleMode::Production: full nmath only for norm_rand_kernel.cl)
description: Mirrors C++ behavior for R's load_library_for_kernel(..., depends_tag = "all_depends_nmath"): when a launcher matches a trigger, every indexed .cl stem in kernel_dependency_index.rds is concatenated (same as load_kernel_library("nmath") full tree). Schema v2 drops the former @all_depends_nmath token trigger for qDiscrete_search; Production assembly no longer upgrades on that token — use proper @all_depends_nmath transitive lists from attach_cross_library_tags.

triggers.cause_summary: Indexed subset omits dependencies such as sunif.cl; device link fails (e.g. R_unif_index on NVPTX). Matches C++ Production: full inst/cl/nmath when the launcher path ends with this suffix.
